attributes.board_name: Washington State Board of Hearing and Speech (Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, seminars, workshops and postgraduate programs of accredited educational institutions; courses offering clock hours or CEUs from profession-related organizations or industries; programs provided, sponsored or endorsed by profession-related organizations; presenting/panel work (max 8 hours per 3 years); written, video, internet or audio programs with proof of completion or non-self-graded tests. Multicultural education on removing barriers to care: max 5 hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Must take and pass the board-approved jurisprudence examination within the first year of licensure (counts as 1 CE hour). Health equity training due by the end of the second full CE reporting period after initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Random CE compliance audits under WAC 246-12-170 through 246-12-240.

topics.who: All credential holders, at least 1 hour per 3 years
All credential holders: passing the board-approved jurisprudence examination counts as the required 1 hour
All credential holders, every 3 years (WAC 246-828-505; WAC 246-12-800 to 246-12-830); counts toward the 30 hours

rules.notes: 30 hours every three years, of which at least 25 must relate to profession-specific skills and competencies; includes 1 hour infection control, 1 hour jurisprudence exam and 2 hours health equity. The same rule covers audiologists, speech-language pathologists and speech-language pathology assistants (and hearing aid specialists). Licenses renew yearly; CE is reported in a 3-year cycle. Current text of WAC 246-828-510 effective Dec 31, 2025 (WSR 25-09-055).
